note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code: real outbound shipments to Qatar (Port Hamad), Canada (Calgary) and Morocco (Casablanca) in Dec 2025, all under HS 34024200 (polyoxyethylene/polyoxypropylene surfactants), plus inbound raw-material imports from USA/China under HS 34024200 and 34042000. Declared HS codes 292215 and 340290 do not match the observed records: actual traded HS is 34024200 (and 34042000 on import), so the code should be corrected to the factual one; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) and registry pages (zaubacorp) returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is 'unknown' with null evidence rather than 'none_found' — absence of public data is not proof of absence of domestic supplies. Address on record: 7, Anand Society, Part-1, Opp Jaymala Society, Bhadwat Nagar (Gujarat, Surat area, consistent with Mundra/Nhava Sheva lanes). Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free view — null, not estimated.
